text.en:
The total cost of the Bucao Toll Bridge, in the province
of Zambales, plus interest at the rate of 5 per cent per an-
num having been fully recovered, as certified in accordance
with the provisions of Act No. 3500, as amended, it is
hereby ordered that the collections of tolls at the Bucao
Toll Bridge be terminated!.
,,-
This order shall take e:Faect upon receipt of copy hereof
by the provincial treasurer of Zambales.
Done in'the City of Manila, this 18th day of July, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-six, and of
the Independence of the Philippines, the eleventh.
By the President:
RAMON MAGSAYSAY
President of the Philippines
FORTUNATO DE LEOiN
